article.summary_en: This church in Brooklyn appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry. It distributes food on Thursdays from 1:30pm to 5pm.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la Ciudad.
Reparte alimentos los jueves de 1:30pm a 5pm.
Está ubicada en 88 Hanson Pl, Brooklyn, NY, 11217.
Puede llamar al (718) 230-0229 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no dice qué alimentos da ni qué requisitos pide; pregunte por teléfono.
how_they_help_en: It is listed as a food pantry on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It distributes food on Thursdays from 1:30pm to 5pm.
It is located at 88 Hanson Pl, Brooklyn, NY, 11217.
You can call (718) 230-0229 to ask before you go.
The listing does not say what food is given or what is required; ask by phone.
